mapper.sql: id, trade_id, uid, symbol, is_buyer, trade_time, original_qty, matched_qty, remaining_qty, match_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO binance_spot_trade_match_state (trade_id, uid, symbol, is_buyer, trade_time, original_qty, matched_qty, remaining_qty, match_status) SELECT t1.id, t1.uid, t1.symbol, t1.is_buyer, t1.time, CASE WHEN t1.is_buyer = 1 AND t1.commission_asset = LEFT(t1.symbol, LENGTH(t1.symbol) - 4) THEN GREATEST(t1.qty - t1.commission, 0) ELSE t1.qty END, 0, CASE WHEN t1.is_buyer = 1 AND t1.commission_asset = LEFT(t1.symbol, LENGTH(t1.symbol) - 4) THEN GREATEST(t1.qty - t1.commission, 0) ELSE t1.qty END, 'PENDING' FROM binance_trade_info t1 WHERE t1.uid = #{uid} AND t1.symbol = #{symbol} AND t1.qty > 0 AND t1.time IS NOT NULL AND t1.is_buyer IN (0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, t.price, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.trade_id = #{tradeId} AND s.is_buyer = 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price, t.order_id, t.commission, t.commission_asset, t.commission_quote_amount, t.commission_valuation_status FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 0 AND s.remaining_qty > 0 AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price, t.order_id, t.commission, t.commission_asset, t.commission_quote_amount, t.commission_valuation_status, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.trade_id = #{sourceTradeId} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.remaining_qty > COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND ( s.trade_time < #{sellTime} OR (s.trade_time = #{sellTime} AND s.trade_id < #{sellTradeId}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price, t.order_id, t.commission, t.commission_asset, t.commission_quote_amount, t.commission_valuation_status, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND t.order_id = #{sourceOrderId} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.remaining_qty > COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND ( s.trade_time < #{sellTime} OR (s.trade_time = #{sellTime} AND s.trade_id < #{sellTradeId}) ) ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, t.price, t.order_id, t.commission, t.commission_asset, t.commission_quote_amount, t.commission_valuation_status, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AS active_core_qty FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.remaining_qty > COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(c.core_qty) FROM binance_spot_core_position c WHERE c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL ), 0) AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND ( s.trade_time < #{sellTime} OR (s.trade_time = #{sellTime} AND s.trade_id < #{sellTradeId}) ) ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE binance_spot_trade_match_state SET matched_qty = #{matchedQty}, remaining_qty = #{remainingQty}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.trade_id, s.uid, s.symbol, s.is_buyer, s.trade_time, s.original_qty, s.matched_qty, s.remaining_qty, s.match_status, s.create_time, s.update_time, t.price, t.order_id, t.commission, t.commission_asset, t.commission_quote_amount, t.commission_valuation_status, c.id AS core_position_id, COALESCE(c.core_qty, 0) AS active_core_qty, c.locked_at AS core_locked_at FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id LEFT JOIN binance_spot_core_position c ON c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.match_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL') AND s.remaining_qty > 0 ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM binance_trade_info t INNER JOIN ( SELECT uid, symbol, trade_id, SUM(core_qty) AS core_qty FROM binance_spot_core_position WHERE released_at IS NULL GROUP BY uid, symbol, trade_id ) c ON c.uid = t.uid AND c.symbol = t.symbol AND c.trade_id = t.id WHERE t.uid = #{uid} AND t.symbol = #{symbol} AND t.is_buyer = 1 AND c.core_qty > CASE WHEN t.commission_asset = LEFT(t.symbol, LENGTH(t.symbol) - 4) THEN GREATEST(t.qty - t.commission, 0) ELSE t.qty END
mapper.update: UPDATE binance_spot_core_position c INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.uid = c.uid AND t.symbol = c.symbol AND t.id = c.trade_id INNER JOIN binance_spot_trade_match_state s ON s.uid = c.uid AND s.symbol = c.symbol AND s.trade_id = c.trade_id SET c.core_qty = GREATEST(c.core_qty - t.commission, 0), c.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE c.uid = #{uid} AND c.symbol = #{symbol} AND c.released_at IS NULL AND t.is_buyer = 1 AND t.commission_asset = LEFT(t.symbol, LENGTH(t.symbol) - 4) AND t.commission > 0 AND c.core_qty = s.remaining_qty AND c.core_qty > GREATEST(t.qty - t.commission, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state WHERE uid = #{uid} AND symbol = #{symbol}
